subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land as the focused fresh-session fix now, or should it pause until the reattach-first recovery design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200 is chosen?
rationale: The code fix is narrow and well covered, but accepted-disconnect fallback behavior is user-visible and can still duplicate model/tool/delivery side effects across sessions.

options.title: Land focused fix now
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for this rare path and handle reattach-first recovery as the linked follow-up.

options.title: Extend into reattach-first
options.body: Ask the contributor to make the PR wait for the accepted gateway run before falling back locally, trading a larger behavior change for fewer duplicate side effects.

options.title: Pause until product direction
options.body: Keep the PR open but do not merge until a maintainer decides the disconnect recovery policy in the linked issue.

recommendation.title: Land focused fix now
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run boundary for this rare path and handle reattach-first recovery as the linked follow-up.
